findings.title: Use dependency ranges and commit a sidecar lockfile
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-18 requires dependency version ranges and a committed lockfile update. The new Python requirements pin exact versions, and the reviewed sidecar tree contains no lockfile, so dependency resolution cannot follow that project rule; declare compatible ranges and commit a lockfile.

findings.quote:
DATA_DIR: Path = Path("/tmp/voiceover-tts")

# Generation queue: serial processing to prevent GPU contention
_generation_queue: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue()
_generations: dict = {}  # id -> {status, error, audio_path}
findings.title: Sidecar API and process lifecycle are concentrated in one module
findings.description: The new 685-line server module owns process watchdog/startup, generation queue state and workflow, and endpoints for transcription, YouTube extraction, profiles, and model management. These are separate responsibilities with different change and failure paths; keeping them together makes routine route or lifecycle changes harder to isolate and test. Split the API into focused routers and move generation orchestration and process lifecycle out of the route module, leaving server.py as app wiring.

findings.title: Transcription blocks the async server loop
findings.description: `transcribe()` synchronously loads and runs the Whisper model, potentially taking a long time, directly inside an async FastAPI handler. This blocks Uvicorn's event loop, so health checks and unrelated requests cannot be served during transcription; the Rust `ensure_running` health check can then treat the busy sidecar as dead and restart it, interrupting the request. Run the synchronous inference in a worker thread, as the code already does for model loading and YouTube downloads. The same issue also occurs at `server.py:245` in `/transcribe-path`.

findings.title: Core speech generation flow has no regression test
findings.description: The new endpoint drives Qwen model loading, sample prompt creation, chunked synthesis, generation status transitions, and audio output. The added binary smoke script creates a profile and sample but never downloads the Qwen model or calls `/generate`, so none of the feature's main success or failure behavior is exercised by a test. Add a controlled integration test that submits generation and verifies terminal status plus playable audio, including a failed-generation case.

findings.title: SSRF: YouTube extractor fetches arbitrary URLs (CWE-918)
findings.description: The `url` comes directly from the create-voice form and is passed to yt-dlp without checking its scheme or host. A user can supply a URL for a loopback, private-network, or link-local service, causing the desktop process to fetch that resource with the user's network access; yt-dlp's generic extractor also handles non-YouTube URLs. Restrict the parsed URL to HTTPS YouTube hosts (including the supported short-link host) before invoking yt-dlp, and reject unsupported protocols and redirects to other hosts.

findings.title: Validate user supplied ffmpeg arguments
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-15 requires validating user supplied values before passing them as child-process arguments. `start` and `duration` come directly from the extraction request and are inserted into the ffmpeg argument list without validation, so reject invalid time values before invoking ffmpeg.

findings.title: The downloaded Whisper repository differs from the one transcription loads
findings.description: The setup download stores `mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo`, while `tts.transcribe` loads `openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo`. Those are distinct Hugging Face repository cache entries, so a user can see Whisper marked downloaded after setup yet still trigger a separate model fetch on first transcription; offline users then cannot transcribe despite completing the model download step.

findings.quote:
if echo "$DL" | grep -q "Download complete\|progress"; then
    pass "POST /models/download accepts whisper model name"
findings.title: Model download smoke check passes on error events
findings.description: The sidecar emits an initial SSE event containing `progress` before downloading, and its failure event also contains `progress`. This condition therefore passes even when the Hugging Face download fails, so the only added check for model downloads reports success without proving completion. Parse the final SSE event and require a successful completion (and verify the model status afterward).

findings.title: Do not silently suppress transcription metadata errors
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-12 explicitly forbids `except Exception: pass`. If reading audio metadata fails, transcription silently returns a zero duration, hiding the failure from the caller; log the error or propagate it instead.

findings.title: Non-English voice profiles always generate English speech
findings.description: The voice setup lets users choose a profile language, and the TTS engine maps multiple language codes, but the recording pipeline always sends `en` with the transcribed text. Thus recordings for a non-English profile are synthesized as English (or fail for text the model cannot render in English), regardless of the selected profile language; the generated test voice also hardcodes English.

findings.title: Validate the frontend supplied sidecar path
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-07 requires Tauri commands to validate paths and URLs received from the frontend before using them. `sidecar_fetch` concatenates the unrestricted `path` directly into a localhost request URL, allowing callers to select arbitrary sidecar endpoints; restrict it to the supported route set or validate the path before constructing the URL.

findings.title: Check HTTP status before reading the response body
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-09 requires checking each outbound HTTP response status before reading its body. `sidecar_fetch` consumes the body first and only then branches on the status, so non-success responses are read as if they were successful; check status before calling `text()`.

findings.title: Duplicate model-status request logic (DRY)
findings.description: This new command repeats the sidecar startup, `/models/status` request, timeout, status handling, and response decoding already implemented by `local_tts::check_model_status`. Keeping both copies means changes to this endpoint's response or error handling must be made in two places and can drift. Extract the shared request and decoding into one helper and have both commands call it.

findings.title: Avoid unwrap on fallible sidecar state lock
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-06 forbids production unwraps outside unrecoverable startup code. This is runtime sidecar startup state, so a poisoned lock panics instead of returning the command's Result error; handle poisoning and propagate an error.

findings.title: The model download wizard treats its SSE response as JSON
findings.description: When a first-time user downloads either model, `/models/download` returns `text/event-stream` records (`data: {...}`), but this method routes the body through `jsonRequest`, which calls `JSON.parse` on it. The download may finish on the sidecar, but parsing throws before the wizard refreshes model status or advances, so the user remains stuck on setup and must reload the page to continue.

findings.title: Retry timer survives page teardown
findings.description: The timeout is scheduled from `onMount` but its handle is not retained or cleared by the component's `onDestroy` cleanup. If the user navigates away before it fires, the callback still issues a Tauri request and may update this page's reactive state after teardown. Store the timeout handle and clear it on destroy; also account for the async mount continuation when cleanup happens before this line runs.

findings.title: Handle failures when loading local voices
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-05 forbids empty catches and requires IPC failures to be reported or rethrown. Selecting the local provider silently discards a failed voice-list request, leaving the user without an explanation; report the error through the UI or logger.

findings.title: Update user documentation for the new voice source flow
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-20 requires README or docs updates for user-visible behavior changes. This change adds YouTube extraction and replaces the documented external Voicebox setup with a bundled TTS sidecar, but README.md remains unchanged and still instructs users to install and run Voicebox. Update the user documentation to describe the bundled sidecar and new sample flow.
